# IP-6 Research

> IP-6 Research, Inc. (Lutherville, Maryland) presents the published research on inositol hexaphosphate (IP6, phytic acid) and inositol: molecular mechanisms, experimental studies, and early human studies. The research began with experiments by Professor AbulKalam M. Shamsuddin at the University of Maryland School of Medicine in 1985. The site is a research reference, not medical advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.ip-6.net/): Overview of IP6 and inositol research, research topics, and selected primary literature.
- [About us](https://www.ip-6.net/about/): The history of IP-6 Research and its investigations into IP6, inositol, cancer biology, immune activity, and early clinical evidence.
- [The science](https://www.ip-6.net/science/): Molecular mechanisms of IP6 and inositol: antioxidant chemistry, cell differentiation, signaling, angiogenesis, and epigenetics.
- [Research areas](https://www.ip-6.net/benefits/): IP6 and inositol research in neuroscience, cardiovascular biology, kidney stones, glucose metabolism, bone biology, and cellular responses to radiation.
- [Our scientist](https://www.ip-6.net/scientist/): Scientific biography of AbulKalam M. Shamsuddin, M.B., B.S., PhD.
- [Research insights](https://www.ip-6.net/news/): IP6 citrate patents, bone and dental studies, clinical pilot evidence, and scientific books.
- [FAQ](https://www.ip-6.net/faq/): Answers on mineral binding, safety terminology, combinations, sources, and interactions.
- [Contact](https://www.ip-6.net/contact/): info@ip-6.net, +1 410-878-2221.
